snippet.title: Nirin Trailer
snippet.description:
Nirin is a motorbike game with a street racing flair from Namco Bandai. Players can choose from a variety of different bikes to ride on, with up to four players able to race one another at the same time. The machine has a High Definition (1368x768) 32 inch LCD monitor and is powered by Namco's System ES1 hardware.

for more information please visit
http://www.highwaygames.com//products/view.php?id=3528
